task: binary: monthly price rises > 2% next month
model: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=200, learning_rate=0.03, l2_regularization=1.0, max_leaf_nodes=15, frozen) - v4 candidate, selected on rolling origins 2016-2022 only (development-exposed data, not a holdout)
protocol: chronological train -> calibrate -> evaluate, frozen before run, evaluated once
dataset_development_exposure: entire dataset was exposed during development (framing, model class, features, hyperparameters); numbers are a retrospective evaluation of a frozen pipeline, not an independent test
asof_serving_rule: as-of scores are served only for months after the calibration window (>= 2025-10); every fit/calibration date strictly precedes every served date
